rubric.role_summary: Senior individual-contributor analyst investigating ransomware through blockchain tracing, cyber threat intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution; produces intelligence and leads for investigations and asset recovery.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior individual-contributor analyst investigating ransomware through blockchain tracing, cyber threat intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution; produces intelligence and leads for investigations and asset recovery.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cybercrime analysis, threat intelligence, financial crime investigations, or a comparable senior analytical role.
- Hands-on experience tracing cryptocurrency funds across blockchains.
- Ransomware domain expertise.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in government, national security, law enforcement, incident response, or mature private-sector investigative or threat intelligence programs.
- Familiarity with OSINT, cybercrime infrastructure research, and cross-domain analysis combining on-chain and off-chain signals.
- Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured-data platforms.
- Experience conducting HUMINT collection and engaging threat actors through dark web forums and encrypted messaging platforms.
- Experience mentoring peers, shaping analytical standards, or improving investigative workflows without formal people management.
- Advanced practitioner-level knowledge of crypto forensics concepts.
- Subject-matter depth and a track record of shaping investigative methodology or strategy beyond individual cases.
- Deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques.
- Demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into written intelligence products.
- Ransomware domain expertise, including understanding of the broader cybercrime ecosystem and relationships among its participants.
- Experience using AI tools and LLMs to support research and analytical workflows, including critically evaluating their outputs.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: United States or United Kingdom (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in one of these places. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
